raw_comment:
I notice that the areas in the Midwest are the most affected by droughts. I wonder if it may be a possibility that these areas are in the middle of the county and furthest away from the ocean which is why they are the most affected

I wonder how the people and communities in the areas exceptionally affected by drought are coping with this and how they are getting access to water.

How does this relate to you and your community?
these droughts relate to my community because I live in New York where it is abnormally dry. We should bring attention to this fact in the community to spread awareness.
